scope: Physical XCTest sends consecutive lateral one-finger drags in a single timed event record. Each travels 56% of the grid over 138 ms and lifts at 145 ms. Each new touch starts 115 ms after the previous lift. Initial runs exercise pairs. The extended cases also exercise four forward flicks and reversals in a four-gesture chain. Lagging date, lost input, missing geometry and other failures remain visible. Numeric UIKit callbacks are observation points and do not measure input-to-display latency.
